Thanks for the ping. Finance can provisionally approve a PO to the operating LLC provided we receive two items: 1) a bank letter on bank letterhead confirming the operating LLC's account and referencing the holding company (ties the legal names together), and 2) a copy of the operating LLC's EIN confirmation or an invoice sample showing the operating company name and TIN.

Because the W-8BEN-E is an IRS form for foreign payees, we also need to confirm treaty status — Kim, can Legal confirm if the W-8BE declares beneficial owner consistent with payments? If not, we may request a corrected W-8 or an additional attestation.

Amira — if you can upload the bank letter and either an EIN confirmation or a recent invoice PDF, Finance will unblock the PO. We can issue a conditional PO flagged "provisional - pending full tax tie-out" and set a 30-day remediation SLA.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Accounting Manager, Redwood Inference
